top_signals.title: Korean Data Center Firm Elice Jumps by Limit After Debut Slump
top_signals.summary: South Korean AI computing supplier Elice Inc. surged on Wednesday, recovering much of the ground lost after a 32% slump in its trading debut, as a string of upbeat US tech earnings lifted sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
